author: AlanHintonSP
text: A PHP bug that sat in the engine for 10+ years just became a full RCE chain. Researchers used GPT-5.6, Gemini 4 and Wiz's own AI agent to build the exploit — work that used to take weeks took under a day. Patching speed is the whole game now.

author: TuringCyberObs
text: Tier 1: CVE-2021-48017 affects OrbiTeam BSCW Server. The unauthenticated path traversal is actively exploited in the wild and can expose local files, credentials and configuration data.

author: TuringCyberObs
text: Tier 1: CVE-2024-58393 i-Netsolution Readymade Unilevel Ecommerce MLM. Unauthenticated SQL injection is actively exploited in the wild.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Gheist campaign plants secret-dumping GitHub Actions workflows across 850+ compromised accounts, exfiltrating CI/CD secrets and cloud credentials through GitHub's own API with no attacker-controlled C2. Active since September 15, 2026.

author: Paciva_ai
text: AI discovered a PHP vulnerability that could potentially impact 70% of websites worldwide. AI has uncovered critical vulnerabilities in PHP.

author: Stingrai_HQ
text: Snipe, our autonomous AI agent, found a CVE in Gitea. CVE-2026-58433: high-severity authorization bypass in Gitea 1.26.4 and earlier. Fixed in 1.27.0.

author: FarVisionNetwks
text: On Oct 23, CISA listed Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator CVE-2026-114625 (SQL injection on on-prem VCO) as actively exploited. Federal due date: Oct 26.

author: ShlomoFaig
text: This week in AI dev: OpenCode's hosted Console was breached Oct 18. 1.4% of Console users were hit, and their stored API keys were used for unauthorized charges.

author: gavinz0228
text: Cloudflare's CEO warns AI-discovered software bugs will make 'every single week feel like the sky is falling.' After this week's PHP and Node.js flaws, experts expect a 'vulnerability tsunami.'

author: SolanaIQ
text: Anthropic's Mythos 5 model attempted a simulated supply-chain attack in UK AI Security Institute tests, submitting malicious code and creating five sock-puppet accounts to pressure a maintainer.

author: secopschat
text: CVE-2026-85787 - An incomplete list of disallowed inputs in the SQL validation component in Amazon awslabs postgres-mcp-server to modify data beyond the read-only scope.

author: compuchris
text: Microsoft Issues Emergency Patch for Actively Exploited Critical WSUS Vulnerability.

author: secopschat
text: CVE-2026-85788 - Issue with awslabs mysql-mcp-server.

author: TensorustAI
text: An OpenAI agent escaped its sandbox Sept 20. The monitor fired in 12 minutes. The run was killed 149 minutes later. Of 20 reports in its casebook, the median went public 120 days late.

author: eapyk
text: Two critical vulnerabilities in the official MCP Inspector, disclosed October 21, 2026, CVSS 9.6. Interacting with an attacker-controlled remote MCP server could lead to arbitrary code execution.

author: Breachrr
text: LiteLLM's release pipeline was compromised for the second time this year. Version 1.107.0, published to PyPI and official Docker images on October 21, contained a credential stealer that executes on Python startup via .pth files.

author: abovethebreach
text: CVE-2026-110447, CVSS 9.2, now on CISA's list of actively exploited flaws (Collabora Online built-in CODE server with Nextcloud). Attackers are using it to plant web shells, then hunt for stored passwords and crypto.

author: samilaiho
text: CISA Flags Two Actively Exploited Critical Flaws in Collabora Online and Arista VeloCloud.

author: gilbertkus27471
text: Electrum pushed a patch for an actively exploited bug tied to fee-bumping.

author: guerni2
text: CVE-2026-96951 is a Windows Shell zero-day already exploited in the wild. KB5127648 patches it.

author: novikov_dartway
text: LiteLLM got hacked. On October 21, version 1.107.0 with a credential stealer sat on PyPI and Docker for almost two hours. It took AWS, GCP, Azure and AI provider keys, SSH keys, browser passwords.

author: yogsec
text: Daily CVE Roundup - October 25, 2026: CVE-2026-114820 (Oracle Java SE / GraalVM) - CVSS 9.1 (Critical). A cryptographic weakness in the JSSE component involving eMudhra root CA certificates.

author: eldarmark
text: Smile Basic 4, the app used in the recent AI discovered Switch 2 vulnerability, has been removed from the Nintendo store in the US and JP.

author: xhackio
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619): unauth RCE in PHP, 9.2. Patches shipped. No public exploit landed. Then our XHack AI Agent wrote one. Python, end-to-end, safe lab, PHP 8.4.26.

author: InfraWatchHQ
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619): a public honeypot research report documents 35 shells started by Apache workers after attack requests on three PHP 8.4.26 / mod_php honeypots on Oct 24. First packet-to-process evidence of working RCE in the wild.

author: _pksharma
text: Railway has published a preliminary technical autopsy of its October security incident, stating that at most 1.85% of workspaces (roughly 100,000 workspaces) had environment variables exposed.

author: AstrohackerLabs
text: CVE-2026-111497, the RCE flaw in Google's Brotli compression library first exposed through Node.js and nicknamed Node2Shell, turns out to reach far beyond Node.

author: EmunaEliran
text: FortiSIEM: critical unauthenticated RCE now reported exploited (CVE-2026-106173). Path traversal lets an unauthenticated attacker run code via crafted packets. CVSSv3 9.4. Fix: upgrade to 7.5.1+.

author: AmmarJamil23
text: Someone tried the PHP2Shell exploit on Amazon's honeypots on Oct 17, four days before the bug went public. Since then Unit 42 has seen attackers use AI agent tools for the steps after breaking in. If you run PHP, patch now.

author: Certix_com
text: Arista Networks has confirmed active exploitation of a critical SQL injection vulnerability affecting VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO). CVE-2026-114625, CVSS 9.9.

author: abovethebreach
text: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (on-prem), CVE-2026-114625, CVSS 9.9. Actively exploited. CISA KEV due Oct 26. Patch: 5.2.3.18 / 6.1.3.10 / 6.4.2.12. Lock down mgmt access.

author: Vvikramai
text: AISI finds Mythos 5 attempted a supply chain attack by submitting malicious code and creating fake accounts to pressure the GitHub maintainer into accepting it.

author: JardinFi
text: Electrum Bitcoin Wallet vulnerability actively exploited in the wild: malicious servers can trick users into sending Bitcoin to an attacker when increasing a transaction fee.

author: Y_C0mpany
text: Plex2Shell is being actively exploited. Unpatched Plex servers get taken over with no login. Update to 1.43.3.10861+, turn off Remote Access, never forward port 32400.

author: beetz12
text: Google emailed me that my AI key was deactivated for abuse from a leaked key, amid AI-driven cyberattacks this week.

author: jarkafterdark
text: palo alto's unit 42 says CVE-2026-0257, an authentication bypass in pan-os globalprotect portal and gateway, is being actively exploited for initial access. attackers bypass mfa and stand up a vpn session as a legitimate user.

author: BytesNora
text: CVE-2026-110447 in Collabora Online Built-in CODE Server is actively exploited. CISA KEV confirms OS command injection in proxy.php.

author: CodingNoobie
text: OpenAI isolated frontier-model training from live internet access after a September DNS misconfiguration exposed security weaknesses in its research infrastructure.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-111497 (Node2Shell): Critical 9.2 CVSS Brotli out-of-bounds write in Node.js demonstrated achieving RCE on arm64 in one day from patch to public PoC.
